configs.label: Boss / Elite / Spark tags in the monster list

tooltip.tooltipText: Writes Boss, Elite or Spark at the bottom of the monster's frame in the list.

configs.label: Hide loot limited to other monster levels

tooltip.tooltipText: Off (default) = show all loot of the monster. On = hide entries the game would not drop at the monster's level.
Upper bound for the icons the mod adds to the window, most likely drops first.
